_about: Test bench presets (dev builds only). Each preset is a button; its lines are sent in order, each delayMs after the one before. Text is exactly what the game writes, without the [timestamp] - the bench stamps it with the current time. Add a preset by adding an entry; group decides which heading it sits under.
